rows.business_description:
Lice Free Noggins is a professional, in-home head lice removal service dedicated to providing safe, effective, and convenient treatment for families. We specialize in the complete removal of head lice and nits using our proprietary Noggins Method™, a meticulous, strand-by-strand process designed to eliminate infestations thoroughly without the use of harsh chemicals.

Our services are fully mobile, allowing us to deliver care directly in the client’s home. This model prioritizes privacy, comfort, and efficiency, eliminating the need for families to travel to clinics or salons. We understand the urgency and stress associated with lice infestations, which is why we offer flexible scheduling, including same-day, late-night, and emergency appointments.

In addition to residential services, Lice Free Noggins partners with both public and private schools to provide on-site head lice screenings and treatment services. We work directly with school administrators, nurses, and staff to conduct professional lice checks, identify active cases, and provide immediate, discreet treatment when needed. Our school-based services help reduce the spread of lice within classrooms while minimizing disruption for students and families.

Lice Free Noggins has built a strong reputation for reliability, professionalism, and consistent results. Since our founding, we have helped over 48,000 families become completely lice-free. Our services are trusted and frequently recommended by parents, school nurses, and pediatric professionals due to our thorough approach and commitment to safety.

We use only non-toxic, pesticide-free products and techniques aligned with widely accepted public health guidance. Our process focuses on the manual removal of both lice and eggs (nits), which is widely recognized as the most effective method for preventing reinfestation. Every treatment is performed with attention to detail and care, ensuring a high standard of service for each client.

In addition to treatment, we provide education and support to families, helping them understand prevention, aftercare, and best practices for managing lice in the household. Our goal is not only to resolve the immediate issue but also to equip clients with the knowledge needed to avoid future occurrences.

Lice Free Noggins stands behind the quality of its work with a 30-day service guarantee, reinforcing our commitment to delivering complete and lasting results. Our business is built on a foundation of trust, discretion, and customer satisfaction, and we continue to grow through strong client relationships and partnerships with families, schools, and community organizations.

EcoPlum® in a certified B Corporation and woman-owned business that offers superior, eco-friendly promotional products that help organizations showcase their brand and values. Our products are not only fun, unique, and high-quality, they are also affordable and backed by a team of attentive and responsive thought leaders who go the extra mile to deliver unmatched service. 

At EcoPlum, we have a saying: Sustainability. Meet Style®. In other words, we believe you shouldn’t have to sacrifice one for the other. 
Our products embody a blend of style, quality, ecological sustainability, and social awareness to support a positive brand image and a shared commitment to protecting our planet and the people within. Our goal is to disrupt the promotional products industry and reduce the amount of plastic and waste produced by conventional products. With highly personalized service, we help buyers make responsible, more sustainable choices on their branded gifts to help elevate their marketing practices while serving a greater purpose. 

EcoPlum blends style, quality, ecological sustainability, and social awareness to deliver values-based promotional products to purpose-driven organizations that want to make a difference. Beyond our commitment to quality and service, businesses choose us for our environmentally sound alternatives to the less eco-friendly conventional products that fill our oceans and landfills. When you work with us, you get a partner whose values align with yours in a shared commitment to protecting our planet and the people within. With a passion for environmental awareness, we don’t just supply you with promotional products you can feel good about, we also offer insights into today’s environmental challenges and the crucial role you play as business leaders. Our Sustainable Swag®-branded promotional products meet strict sustainability criteria to deliver unique, high-quality reusable and usable gifts that help you showcase your brand and values.

EcoPlum is a member of the American Sustainable Business Council (ASBC) and the Association for the Advancement of Sustainability in Higher Education (AASHE) and a proud recipient of the Green America Gold Business Seal of Approval. As a successful Women’s Business Enterprise National Council (WBENC)-certified business and a certified B-Corp, we are passionate about supporting the environment while giving back to other women-owned businesses and small businesses. Our President and CEO, Gia Machlin, is an active member of the Women Presidents Organization and also sits on the advisory board for Enterprising Women (EW) magazine. She also earned the coveted 2020 Enterprising Women of the Year designation. Widely revered for our sustainability practices, EcoPlum has been featured on Forbes Books Podcast, Green is Good Radio, WOR Talk Radio, Crain’s New York, INC, magazine, Café Mom, and many other business publications and shows.

rows.business_description:
Kadidja Handmade Collection (“Kadidja”), established in 2021, is a for-profit LLC; a woman- and minority-owned business located in the Lower East Side of NYC, I am passionate about creating handcrafted skincare.

The Products
High-quality premium shea butter- and Shea nut oil - based natural A cosmetics, infused with essential oils, are formulated as a hand balm (four products), body lotion, Lip balms (four products) therapeutic lotion, Soap, Candle and Botanical Herbs.  

The Kadidja Story:
I arrived from Burkina Faso to the USA in 2002 and brought shea with me - shea trees grow only in West Africa, and are the source of shea butter and shea nut oil. In New York City, I made shea lotions for my family and often gave some away as gifts to friends. People loved my products and encouraged me to start making them to sell. I started selling them at our local farmer's market, where they were also popular, and I started supplying two local boutiques. I use 100% all-natural shea butter and shea nut oil, which I have selected myself on visits to Burkina Faso, Ghana, and Togo.

Brand Attributes:
Premium quality, handmade skincare products made with all-natural, pure Shea butter and Shea nut oil
Kadidja products support the economic empowerment of African women – I buy my Shea butter from women’s groups, paying a premium price for their handmade Shea butter
Kadidja’s products support environmental conservation – by making Shea trees valuable for their Shea fruits and nuts, the trees are less likely to be cut down for use as firewood or building materials.

At Bamboo Yoshi, we offer sustainable packaging, biodegradable bagasse, and other eco-friendly products. **The Genesis:**

Richard Rosario, a passionate photographer with an innate flair for storytelling, envisioned a photography studio that would redefine the art of visual narration in the Bronx community. With a commitment to authenticity and a dedication to his craft, Rosario set out to establish a haven where individuals could immortalize their most cherished moments through the lens of his camera.


**Our Services:**

Richard Rosario Photography LLC prides itself on offering a diverse array of services tailored to cater to the unique needs of its clientele. While weddings may not be on the agenda, our studio specializes in a myriad of other photography genres, including:


1. **Portrait Photography:** From captivating headshots to dynamic family portraits, our studio excels in capturing the essence of every individual or group with finesse and precision.


2. **Corporate Headshots:** In the professional world, a compelling headshot can make all the difference. Richard Rosario Photography LLC offers corporate headshot services designed to capture the professionalism and personality of each individual, helping them make a lasting impression in their field.


3. **Event Coverage:** Whether it's a corporate gathering, a community event, or a milestone celebration, Richard Rosario Photography LLC is dedicated to providing top-tier event coverage that immortalizes the atmosphere and energy of the occasion.


4. **Product Photography:** In an increasingly digital world, the importance of high-quality product imagery cannot be overstated. Our studio offers professional product photography services designed to showcase your merchandise in the best possible light.


5. **Real Estate Photography:** Highlighting the beauty and potential of properties is crucial in the real estate industry. Richard Rosario Photography LLC specializes in capturing stunning images that accentuate the unique features of residential and commercial spaces.


**Our Commitment:**

At Richard Rosario Photography LLC, excellence is not just a goal; it's a standard by which we operate every day. From the moment you walk through our doors to the final delivery of your photographs, our team is dedicated to providing a seamless and exceptional experience that exceeds your expectations.


**Community Engagement:**

As proud members of the Bronx community, we believe in the importance of giving back. Through various outreach programs and collaborations with local organizations, Richard Rosario Photography LLC strives to use its platform to uplift and inspire the next generation of aspiring photographers.


**Looking Ahead:**

As we continue to grow and evolve, Richard Rosario Photography LLC remains committed to pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. With a focus on embracing new technologies and exploring alternative avenues of artistic expression, our studio is poised to remain a trailblazer in the world of photography for years to come.


In a world where moments are fleeting and memories are precious, Richard Rosario Photography LLC stands as a steadfast guardian of the past, present, and future. Join us as we embark on a journey to capture the beauty of life, one frame at a time.

MotionScoop Dance Corp. was established in February 2018 by Marisabel Vasconez (ABT® Certified Teacher) in an effort to provide quality dance training in Queens, NYC. MotionScoop Dance is like an ice cream shop, you choose the flavors of dance that you want to explore, and we build your dance training around this. Mari hopes this process to be individual for each student and partner, yet, inclusive so that participants encounter different points of view within a “dance class” and what it means in each genre.
 
At MotionScoop Dance, we strive to provide quality and pre-professional dance training. We structure our classes with fun and productivity, all while adding elements of technical training for a challenging, rigorous, and rewarding experience. Our instructors are highly trained professionals in their fields. This means that your dancers will receive the most modern and up-to-date dance education in the industry, guaranteed!

MotionScoop Dance Corp. provides dance services through two main branches: 

Our Dance Academy in Queens, NY provides dance education in an open and encouraging atmosphere. Our family-friendly environment has attracted many dancers who are beginning their journey. This program is geared towards children that demonstrate an inclination to the arts and are looking for a program that will guide them to explore and excel in a safe environment.

Secondly, our Youth Dance Community Programs serve public schools in New York City primarily through the Department of Education. As a Minority & Woman-Owned Business Enterprise, we are able to provide quality dance training and cater our lessons to each group that we have the pleasure of teaching. Our mission is to bridge the gap between Concert and Latin Social Dances, as well as their availability to our communities. We believe that ALL children deserve the opportunity and exposure to the arts!

It is our goal to continue sharing our knowledge and Dance Education by partnering with schools around New York City and bringing our highly-qualified faculty to them. We build in-school and after-school programs that are rigorous and appeal to those kids who want a little more dance training and crave a deeper exploration of technique and movement. 

Please reach out with any questions, our team will be delighted to work with your school in order to create an amazing performing and dance program for your kids.

ARC Document Solutions, LLC is a leading provider of document management, printing, and digital solutions for businesses across multiple industries. WIth decades of experience, ARC has evlolved from a traditional reprographics company into a cutting-edge provider of managed print services, digital document solutions, environmental graphics, and large-format printing. By leveraging state-of-the-art technology, ARC helps businesses optimize their document workflows, enhance collaboration, and create visually compelling brand experiences.
ARC operates a vast network of service centers, production facilities, and technology solutions that serve a diverse customer base, including architects, engirneers, contractors, retail brands, corporate offices, and facility managers. The company's expertise in document lifecycle management, from creation and storage to distribution and security, ensures that clients receive customized solutions that streamline their operations and drive efficiency. 

Core Services
1. Print and Document Management Solutions
ARC provides businesses with end-to-end print and document management services, allowing them to reduce costs, improve efficiency, and maintain secure document workflows. Key offerings include:
-Managed Print Services (MPS): ARC optimizes in-office print environments, elping companies lower costs, improve security, and enhance productivity through centralized print management. 
-Digital Document Solutions: Secure cloud-based platforms enable seamless access, retrieval, and sharing of business-critical documents.
-On-Site Print Solutions: ARC deploys dedicated print infrastructure within client facilities to ensure efficient document management without the need for off-site outsourcing.
-Scanning and Archiving: ARC converts paper documents into digital assets, making it easier to store, search, and manage information with improved security and compliance. 

2. Large-Format Printing and Environmental Graphics
ARC's expertise in large-format printing enables businesses to create visually impactful displays, signage, and branding solutions tailored to their needs. We offer: 
-Environmental Graphics: Transforming physical spaces through branded wall murals, floor graphics, and wayfinding signage that enhance customer engagement. 
-Retail and Event Signage: High-quality banners, posters, and promotional displays for in-store branding, trade shows, and corporate events. 
-Custom Digital Displays: Dynamic digital signage solutions that provide real-time content updates for enhanced communication and brand storytelling. 

3. Construction and Building Information Solutions
ARC is a trusted partner for the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry, offering specialized services that streamline document workdflows, improve collaboration, and increase project efficiency. Solutions include: 
-Project Document Management: Digital plaforms that store, track, and distribute construction drawings, specifications, and other critical documents. 
-BIM (Building Information Modeling) Print Services: HIgh-resolution printing of BIM models, blueprints, and construction plans for precise project execution. 
-Jobsite Services: On-demand printing and document delivery directly to construction sites, ensuring teams have the most up-to-date plans available. 

4. Cloud and Digital Transformation Services
As businesses move toward digital-first strategies, ARC supports clients in digitzing workflows, improving accessibility, and enhancing security through: 
-ARC Facilities: A cloud-based facility management solution that allows organizations to store, track and access building plans and maintenance records from anywhere.
-SkySite: A digital project management platform tailored to the construction industry, offering seamless document collaboration and team communication. 
-AI-Driven Document Search and Retrieval: Advanced tools that enable businesses to quickly locate critical files within their document repositories. 

5. Customized Business Solutions
ARC Tailors its services to meet the specific needs of various industries, ensuring that businesses can operate more effieciently while maintaining compliance and security. The compay provides: 
-Corporate Office Solutions: Document security, print optimization, and workplace branding solutions that improve office productivity and employee engagement. 
-Healthcare Solutions: Secure document digitization and print services that support HIPAA compliance and enhance patient experience. 
-Financial Services and Legal SOlutions: Reliable document mangement services that ensure data confidentiality, regulatory compliance, and efficient workflow management.

We specialize in high-volume, government-contracted security assignments, with a strong focus on regulatory adherence, workforce readiness, and operational integrity.

Headquartered in New York City, A&H Security Services brings over 40 years of combined executive leadership experience in public safety, law enforcement, security operations, and contract management. Our core client base includes New York City government agencies, nonprofit organizations, healthcare institutions, schools, construction sites, and private organizations. We pride ourselves on being mission-aligned, results-driven, and community-focused.

A&H Security deploys NYS-licensed unarmed security officers who meet all state-mandated training and background check requirements. Our 24/7 dispatch system and mobile operations team allow us to respond to emergent coverage needs with as little as 1-2 hours’ notice. We maintain a dedicated reserve of trained officers ready for rapid deployment in the event of service interruptions, emergencies, or unforeseen client needs.

With dedicated site inspections, incident reporting protocols, and oversight mechanisms, A&H proactively works with clients to identify and mitigate potential risks. Our in-house compliance team ensures that all assignments meet contract, insurance, and regulatory standards, including OSHA, FDNY, and union requirements.

With a unique blend of research expertise, culturally responsive pedagogy, and interdisciplinary curriculum design, we support K–12 schools, museums, cultural institutions, and education agencies in creating transformative learning experiences.

Our services include:

Professional Development: We design and deliver workshops, webinars, and coaching programs for educators and school leaders, with a focus on culturally responsive teaching, arts integration, and liberatory education practices.

Curriculum Design: We create custom, standards-aligned curricula that center historically marginalized voices, integrate the arts, and support multiliteracies and multimodal learning.

Educational Resource Development: Our team has extensive experience developing digital and print learning materials, including lesson plans, educator guides, and student-facing activities. We specialize in aligning content to local, state, and national learning standards, as well as museum exhibition content.

Public Engagement & Programming: We curate and facilitate interdisciplinary panels, lectures, and creative learning experiences that connect communities to the arts and support public pedagogy.

Our founder, Dr. Jacqueline Cofield, is an award-winning arts-based education researcher and interdisciplinary scholar who has presented nationally at academic and professional conferences. With a background that spans teaching in K–12 public schools, university classrooms, and museum education settings, Dr. Cofield brings a deep commitment to equity, community collaboration, and culturally sustaining pedagogy.

We’ve collaborated with leading institutions such as the Whitney Museum of American Art, Columbia University, SUNY, and the NYC Department of Education. Our work empowers educators, engages students, and transforms systems.

We welcome opportunities to collaborate locally and globally, and are committed to delivering high-quality, impactful, and inclusive educational services that meet the needs of diverse learners and learning environments.

rows.business_description:
Vibrnt Seeds is a culturally grounded, education-driven initiative rooted in the belief that every child deserves access to hands-on learning, fresh food, and opportunities to connect with the natural world. Blooming from the urgent needs revealed during the COVID-19 pandemic, Vibrnt Seeds began as a community response to support essential workers and their families through engaging, garden-based education and food literacy programming. What started as resource kits and virtual lessons has now grown into a dynamic platform that brings urban agriculture, nutrition, and sustainability to life inside classrooms, afterschool programs, and community spaces across New York City.

At its core, Vibrnt Seeds helps young people—and the adults who guide them—rediscover the joy and power of growing food, no matter their background or living situation. Through vibrant partnerships with schools, community centers, shelters, and public housing organizations, Vibrnt Seeds installs edible garden kits, facilitates experiential workshops, and provides technical support to educators, site directors, and caregivers. The program is committed to making growing food a joyful, accessible experience—whether it’s through a hydroponic tower in a cafeteria corner, tabletop gardens in a second-grade classroom, or windowsill herb kits that children proudly take home to their families.

One of the signature features of Vibrnt Seeds is its Tabletop Garden Series, where students engage in hands-on activities that teach science, math, and storytelling through the act of growing. Each child receives their own edible herb kit, designed for indoor growing on a windowsill, which helps extend learning from school into the home. These kits aren’t just plants—they’re a pathway to understanding food systems, building healthy routines, and fostering family connection. The installations are paired with curated lesson plans and simple instructions so that educators—regardless of gardening experience—feel confident leading sessions.

Beyond the classroom, Vibrnt Seeds brings its educational mission into the broader community. The program hosts seasonal events, parent workshops, pop-up plant carts, and garden clubs that make it easy for entire families to participate in growing, cooking, and learning together. Whether working alongside school wellness councils, community-based organizations, or city agencies, Vibrnt Seeds shows up as both a collaborator and a cultivator—helping communities turn small spaces into impactful growing environments that support wellness, creativity, and food access.

Vibrnt Seeds also addresses deeper systemic challenges, such as food insecurity and environmental justice, through programs that connect students to local food sources and green career pathways. Youth are introduced to farming technologies, cultural planting traditions, and even animal husbandry as part of a broader ecosystem of sustainability education. All activities are designed to be joyful, inclusive, and reflective of the communities they serve—particularly Black and Brown youth in historically under-resourced neighborhoods.

What makes Vibrnt Seeds unique is its ability to bridge education with action. The program blends curriculum-aligned learning with real-world experiences that nurture a child’s sense of agency and belonging. At a time when school communities are seeking meaningful ways to support student mental health, family engagement, and culturally responsive learning, Vibrnt Seeds offers a model that is tactile, inspiring, and deeply rooted in care.

Agencies and partners who work with Vibrnt Seeds can expect a hands-on, collaborative process that meets their needs while uplifting the voices of their students and families. Whether you're looking to install a long-term edible garden, run a short-term workshop series, or incorporate youth-friendly wellness initiatives into your programming, Vibrnt Seeds brings passion, expertise, and a deep love for community to every project.

In a city where concrete often replaces soil and fast food overshadows fresh produce, Vibrnt Seeds offers something radical: a way for children and families to grow something real—together.

rows.business_description:
Riverdale Montessori/ Kingsbridge Montessori Schools of Jasmine Educational Enterprises, provides Free Pre-k (4yrs old).

At Riverdale & Kingsbridge Montessori Schools (RMS/KMS) the goal for our children is to provide each child with all the necessary skills and confidence to grow independently. Children are encouraged to reach their full potential through teaching methods that develop the whole personality of the child—not only intellectually, but also their powers of deliberation, initiative, independent choice, and emotional development.  We offer two individualized programs for children ages two to five - Preschool/Toddler Program and Pre-K Program.  This way, children can grow within the organization over 3 years.

The overall goal of each classroom is to have the children enjoying themselves while learning at their own pace, and to begin the education process with a positive approach to learning. We aim to reach this goal by setting meaningful expectations of each child, that when fulfilled, will equip them with the confidence to challenge their individual capability. 

 Those expectations are translated through a curriculum that is less prescribed and more child-centered.
Our goals for our families is to ensure that their child is always safe and nurtured while in our care, but also engaged in a stimulating and enriching early childhood curriculum. Additionally, given that we are in incredibly diverse community, we strongly believe in the importance of providing a for all equal opportunity early childhood education program. 

Our school is one that opens its doors to families of all backgrounds regardless of their religion/race/country of origin.
Our goal for the community is for RMS/KMS to continue be viewed as a resource whereby families that are unable to afford the cost of private education can utilize our programing to provide their preschool aged children with a solid foundation for school aged programming.  This would not be possible without striving to build relationships with other child-centered community resources such as after school programs, local libraries, & public/private schools. Our long-term community goal is for community members to continue to view RMS/KMS at the forefront of the NYC DOE's public Pre-K/early childhood education programing, which is evident in our long-standing relationships with institutions such as the NYC DOE, PS 81, Monroe College, Fordham University, and a continued connection with the community of St James Episcopal Church.

To best support children’s learning and development, we believe that it is imperative to have a rigorous curriculum in a safe and accepting environment, a quality leadership and instructional team, and strong relationships with parents and the community in which we serve. 

One component cannot function without the other.  For one, we cannot have an instructional program without a solid curriculum, and children cannot learn from this curriculum if they do not feel safe and nurtured, but also challenged (rigor) with the support of qualified teachers.  We cannot execute our rigorous programming and give the children safety and love in an environment without teachers and leaders. 

 Finally, the children and the community we serve are the pinnacle of what we do.  Our families must want to come to us, not just to feel welcomed and cared for, but also because of the value that we place on them  - the community and the children we serve. 

Play-based learning: This means that 4 year olds come to school and are stimulated by play, but that they are also engaged in learning while they play.  This comes from engaging in conversations, student to student or teacher to student, that push student thinking and expand vocabularies.  
Choice: By providing students with choice, educators help to boost engagement, which therefore increases learning.  This also allows for children to tap into their interests, again increasing learning.  Finally, this helps to build autonomy and independence, and for children to feel empowered by having a say in their learning.
Student Independence: From early on in a child’s development, they must be taught to do what adults might see as the most basic tasks independently.  Although it is hard to think of with children when they are just 4, if early on they are not taught the skills that are necessary for success in everyday life, then we will not be setting them up for success in elementary school/beyond.  This starts with building student independence.  Student independence is crucial not only with things such as self-care and ability to verbalize, but also with being an independent worker/studier and learning to initiate task on one's own.

Green Spa New York Inc. is a New York State–licensed wellness and therapeutic services company with more than 27 years of continuous experience serving the Brooklyn community and the greater New York City area. Our company delivers professional therapeutic services including medical massage, sports massage, oncology care, prenatal massage, stress-management services, corporate wellness programs, and onsite wellness experiences for both private and public-sector clients. Our team has extensive experience working in educational environments and delivering structured, compliant wellness programs that meet DOE standards.

In addition to therapeutic services, our organization includes an internal professional development and mindset-training division that provides change-management coaching, communication skills workshops, emotional-regulation tools, and leadership development programs. These programs support both individuals and organizations in improving resilience, decision-making, workplace culture, and overall mental wellness. This work enhances our physical wellness services by addressing the behavioral and emotional components of well-being.

Across all programs, we prioritize integrity, structure, professionalism, and measurable outcomes. We maintain detailed internal systems, standard operating procedures, and quality-control processes to ensure consistent, reliable service delivery for all clients and agency partners. Our long-standing history, licensed team, and proven ability to support government, corporate, and community-based clients demonstrate our capacity to fulfill MWBE, DOE, and public-sector contracts with excellence.

Green Spa New York Inc. remains committed to improving the health, wellness, and resilience of the communities we serve by providing high-quality therapeutic care, evidence-based stress-reduction services, and supportive professional development programming.

Mss Francois, LLC is a dynamic multimedia and personal development brand committed to empowering women through humor, storytelling, and transformative experiences. As a Caribbean-American (Trinidadian) entertainer, motivational speaker, confidence coach, and content creator, Mss Francois uses entertainment as a gateway to education, healing, and self-empowerment.

Our services span across keynote speaking, corporate training, one-woman theatrical productions, digital content creation, and interactive workshops. With a signature style that blends comedy with real-life lessons, we engage audiences in meaningful conversations around relationships, identity, self-worth, and purpose.

Key Offerings
Motivational Speaking & Coaching: We deliver high-energy, humorous keynote talks and workshops that inspire audiences to rediscover their confidence, overcome self-sabotage, and embrace their true power. From public health professionals to college students, our talks create lasting impact.

Entertainment & Theate*: Our sold-out, one-woman show *FRUSTRATED* explores love, heartbreak, and growth through laughter. These performances foster healing and community, often paired with interactive mixers and meet-and-greets.

Personal Development Programs: Through our online community and programs like the *IGNITE HER* webinar series, we guide women in identifying their gifts, passions, and purpose with tools like “The Power List,” reflective journals, and themed monthly sessions.

Event Hosting & Production: From emceeing high-level galas and conferences to organizing panel discussions, we create inclusive, empowering spaces that celebrate success and spark dialogue.

Media & Content Creation: As host of a TV show and digital segments like *What Does This Quote Mean to Me*, Mss Francois uses short-form media to motivate, educate, and entertain. We also develop branded content for events and online platforms.

Partnerships & Community Engagement: We collaborate with nonprofits, schools, government agencies, and corporate partners to uplift communities and promote mental, emotional, and relational wellness—especially among women of color.

Our mission is to help women “Get Their Groove Back”—in life, love, and leadership—by laughing through the pain, celebrating the wins, and boldly showing up as their authentic selves. Whether it’s through a stage, a screen, or a small group session, we aim to leave every audience uplifted, empowered, and ready to thrive.

rows.business_description:
Generation Conscious is a sustainable laundry, cleaning, and personal care refill company redefining the future of everyday consumption. 

Our mission is to address hygiene insecurity, deliver equitable access to high quality waste-free products, end the flow of billions of single use plastic containers to landfills and oceans, and work towards an environmentally just future.  

We work with universities and property managers to place detergent sheet refill stations in convenient locations across their campuses. 

How does it work? Students and/or tenants bring refillable containers to the refill stations and purchase a month’s supply of eco-friendly detergent sheets at a time using a credit or debit card. Functionally, detergent sheets work exactly like traditional detergent, just place them in the detergent compartment of the washing machine. One per load. 
Environmentally, sheets have only essential ingredients necessary for cleaning and no excess water or single use plastic packaging, leading to a much lower carbon footprint.  Generation Conscious encourages all partner schools at minimum to cover the costs of detergent sheets for students who qualify for Pell Grants in order to insure we are addressing the issue of hygiene insecurity. In the long run, we hope to expand to other waste free solid personal care and cleaning products. We have already released our second, a toothpaste tablet.

rows.business_description:
When She Comes Home LLC is a wellness and community engagement company dedicated to helping individuals and families prioritize mental, emotional, financial, and physical well-being through meaningful experiences, strategic partnerships, and accessible resources.

Founded by Diana L. Hilaire, When She Comes Home was born from a simple but powerful belief: before we can effectively care for others, we must first care for ourselves. What began as a curated self-care gift box company has evolved into a comprehensive wellness platform that creates safe spaces for education, conversation, connection, and healing.

At When She Comes Home, we believe wellness is not a luxury—it is a necessity. Yet for many people, particularly parents, caregivers, women, and underserved communities, self-care often takes a back seat to the daily demands of life. Our mission is to change that narrative by making wellness approachable, practical, culturally relevant, and community-centered.

We design and produce experiences that empower individuals with the knowledge, tools, and support they need to thrive. Through workshops, panel discussions, educational seminars, networking experiences, and community activations, we bring together experts across multiple disciplines to address the whole person. Our programming explores topics such as mental health, financial wellness, stress management, entrepreneurship, parenting, work-life integration, self-care, physical health, and personal development.

One of our greatest strengths is our ability to build meaningful partnerships that amplify impact. We collaborate with corporations, financial institutions, schools, nonprofit organizations, healthcare professionals, government agencies, and community leaders to deliver high-quality programming that meets people where they are. These partnerships allow us to bridge gaps in access while creating experiences that are informative, engaging, and transformative.

Our signature event series, When Wellness Comes Home, exemplifies this mission. Designed to spark authentic conversations around the connection between mental wellness, financial stability, and self-care, the series brings together licensed therapists, healthcare professionals, financial experts, and community advocates who provide practical strategies participants can immediately implement in their everyday lives. By creating welcoming spaces for honest dialogue, we help remove the stigma surrounding wellness while encouraging individuals and families to invest in themselves.

We recognize that wellness is deeply interconnected. Financial stress affects mental health. Mental health impacts physical health. Family dynamics influence emotional well-being. Because these areas cannot be addressed in isolation, our programming intentionally takes a holistic approach, ensuring participants leave with actionable resources that support every aspect of their lives.

Our work extends beyond adults. We believe that healthy families create healthy communities. As a result, we also develop family-centered programming that equips parents and caregivers with tools to model healthy behaviors, strengthen communication, and build resilient households. By investing in families, we create lasting generational impact.

When She Comes Home also serves as a trusted partner for organizations seeking to strengthen employee engagement, workplace wellness, and community impact initiatives. We customize workshops and experiences that align with organizational goals while fostering healthier, more connected teams. Whether serving employees, clients, students, entrepreneurs, or community members, we create experiences that inspire reflection, encourage action, and promote lasting behavioral change.

Everything we do is rooted in authenticity, collaboration, and service. We intentionally create environments where people feel seen, heard, valued, and supported regardless of where they are in their wellness journey. Our events are designed not only to educate but also to cultivate genuine human connection—because healing often begins with knowing you're not alone.

Looking ahead, When She Comes Home continues to expand its reach through strategic partnerships, community programming, educational initiatives, and corporate collaborations that advance wellness equity. Our vision is to become a nationally recognized leader in holistic wellness experiences that transform individuals, strengthen families, and empower communities to flourish.

At its core, When She Comes Home is more than a brand—it is a movement. A movement that reminds people to pause, breathe, prioritize themselves without guilt, and understand that caring for themselves is one of the greatest investments they can make. Because when wellness comes home, stronger families, healthier workplaces, and more vibrant communities follow.

Yara Shea Beauty is a certified woman-owned social enterprise based in New York dedicated to promoting health, wellness, self-care, and cultural appreciation through premium natural skincare products, wellness experiences, educational programming, and artisan-crafted lifestyle goods. We ethically source shea butter and collaborate with women artisans in West Africa, producing and packaging high-quality products in the United States. This approach creates economic opportunities for underserved women and supports sustainable livelihoods.

Our product line includes handcrafted body butters, body oils, body washes, soaps, candles, aromatherapy products, wellness gift boxes, self-care packages, hygiene kits, handcrafted baskets, home décor, textiles, jewelry, accessories, and culturally inspired artisan gifts. We also provide customized corporate gifts, branded promotional products, employee appreciation gifts, client gifts, conference and event gifts, holiday gifts, and wellness packages tailored to the needs of businesses, government agencies, schools, healthcare organizations, and nonprofit institutions.

Beyond our products, Yara Shea Beauty provides educational and wellness services that promote healthy living, personal care, confidence, leadership, and community well-being. We design and facilitate interactive workshops, trainings, demonstrations, and wellness experiences for students, educators, employees, community organizations, and professional groups.

Our services include:

Employee wellness and self-care workshops
Corporate wellness experiences and staff appreciation programs
Natural skincare education and product demonstrations
Shea butter making classes and hands-on workshops
Personal hygiene education
Menstrual health and hygiene education
School wellness and health promotion programs
Youth leadership and entrepreneurship workshops
Women's empowerment and self-care events
Community health outreach and wellness education
Cultural education featuring African traditions, craftsmanship, and ethical sourcing
Customized wellness activations for conferences, community events, and public engagement initiatives

Yara Shea Beauty also designs and supplies customized hygiene kits, wellness kits, student care packages, teacher appreciation gifts, employee onboarding gifts, conference welcome bags, and community outreach packages that can be tailored to meet procurement specifications and organizational branding requirements.

We proudly serve public and private schools, colleges and universities, corporations, healthcare providers, nonprofit organizations, community-based organizations, government agencies, libraries, museums, faith-based organizations, and event organizers throughout New York City and beyond. Our offerings support employee engagement, student wellness, public health initiatives, community education, cultural programming, and organizational wellness objectives.

As a mission-driven enterprise, Yara Shea Beauty integrates social impact into every aspect of its business. One hundred percent of our profits support the programs of Hope and Dreams Initiative, a nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing education, menstrual health, gender equality, women's economic empowerment, and community development in underserved communities. Every purchase contributes to expanding access to health education, menstrual hygiene resources, leadership development, and economic opportunities for women and girls.

Yara Shea Beauty is committed to delivering exceptional customer service, high-quality natural products, culturally authentic experiences, and innovative wellness solutions. Our combination of product manufacturing, educational programming, customized gifting, and community engagement makes us a unique partner for organizations seeking diverse, socially responsible suppliers capable of providing both products and professional services.

Our goal is to help organizations create healthier workplaces, stronger schools, more engaged communities, and memorable experiences through wellness, education, culture, and purpose-driven products that make a lasting impact.
